title: Recruitment of Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, and Non-Teaching Posts
organization: The Maharaja Bhupinder Singh Punjab Sports University, Patiala
application_fee: Rs. 2000/- for General and Rs. 1500/- for SC/ST/BC/EWS/PWD
age_limit: Max 45 years for college teachers, not less than 18 and more than 37 years for non-teaching posts as on 01.01.2026
summary: The Maharaja Bhupinder Singh Punjab Sports University, Patiala has announced recruitment for various teaching and non-teaching positions across the University and constituent colleges. Interested candidates can apply online through the official website by 04.12.2026 and submit hard copies by 09.12.2026.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must possess the requisite educational qualifications for the specific post as outlined in the notification.
Knowledge of Punjabi language (Matriculation standard) is required for most posts.
Age limits apply depending on whether the post is teaching or non-teaching, with relaxations as per Punjab Government rules.

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official website www.mbspsu.ac.in and fill out the online application form.
Pay the requisite application fee online.
Print four sets of the completed online application form along with self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials.
Send the hard copies by courier, registered post, or by hand to the Registrar, The Maharaja Bhupinder Singh Punjab Sports University, Patiala before the deadline.
